feature_mapping.rationale: Publisher documents 166 features, first 94 local including time; loader excludes txId and time. Hence numeric local raw 2..94, aggregate 95..166.
feature_mapping.limitation: Local columns can themselves contain address/transaction aggregates; removing 72 supplied neighbor aggregates does not eliminate all relational information.

ieee_cis/gnn.review: Construction-tagged 5333c55 source reviewed; epoch loop, loss, optimizer, AP selection and F1 threshold procedure unchanged from 2be96ee; graph selection and output paths differ.

elliptic/gnn.review: Training loops and loss/optimizer/selection reviewed against frozen source; IEEE Transformer is outside this 300-run design.
